Marketing & Brand Ambassador — Hutsenpiller Insurance

Location:
Mt. Juliet, Tennessee

About The Role

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys being the face of our agency. This role is part relationship-builder and part content creator. You'll be out in the community one day and building our digital presence the next.

What You'll Do

Community and referral partnerships:
Represent Hutsenpiller Insurance in the community. You'll visit referral partners and relationship accounts, deliver gifts and thank-yous, and keep those partnerships warm and active.

Community events:
Coordinate and run our presence at local events. For example, if we're sponsoring a golf tournament, you'll set up and host our booth, manage the day, and make sure we show up well.

Social media:
Own our presence on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. That means creating content, keeping a consistent posting schedule, and driving real engagement.

Website and content:
Manage our existing website and write regular blog content that reflects our brand and helps people find us.

Review management:
Help the agency earn new Google reviews and monitor the ones that come in. You'll respond to each review and follow up on anything that needs action.

Email marketing:
Manage our bulk email communications to prospects and clients, from building the sends to keeping the messaging consistent with our brand.

Travel:
This role involves regular driving around the area to visit partners, make deliveries, and attend events, so a reliable vehicle and valid driver's license are required. We cover all fuel costs.

What We're Looking For

Comfort with AI tools, especially Claude
Experience with HubSpot, which our systems are built on
Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently
Someone genuinely comfortable walking into a room and representing a brand
Some evening and weekend availability for events

Benefits

Company-matched 401(k)
Unlimited PTO
Health insurance reimbursement
Profit sharing
All fuel costs covered

Social Media Manager (Part-Time) | Knoxville / Dandridge, TN Area | Hybrid

About Tula AI Labs
Tula AI Labs builds AI agents, automation, and custom dashboards for businesses. We also run social media and marketing for select clients. We’re looking for a strategic, hands-on content creator in East Tennessee to own social for a hospitality client and grow our own brand.

The Role

• Part-time, 20 hours per week
• Mix of on-site and remote work, including one on-site shoot per week at a restaurant and event venue client
• Supports both client accounts and Tula AI Labs’ own social channels
• $24/hour
• Performance measured on social media growth

What You’ll Do

• Build a social media strategy for each account, then implement and execute it
• Film short-form video on-site at the client’s venue every week
• Edit short-form reels and write captions
• Publish one post per day across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube
• Schedule content in Metricool
• Respond to comments and DMs during working hours
• Track performance against growth KPIs and adjust the strategy based on results
• Put together a monthly results report
• Stay current on trends, sounds, and formats, and turn them into content quickly
• Capture behind-the-scenes content that can become client case studies

What We’re Looking For

• 2+ years managing social media for a brand or business, with results you can show
• Proven experience building and executing a social media strategy
• Strong short-form video skills: you film and edit your own content
• A portfolio of short-form video you shot and edited
• Up to date on what’s trending across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
• Strong caption writing and a good eye for food, events, and hospitality
• Organized and self-directed. You’ll own the calendar and the results
• Reliable transportation to the venue each week
• Comfortable using AI tools in your daily workflow (a plus)
• Hospitality or restaurant experience (a plus)

Location
Candidates based in or near Knoxville, Dandridge, Jefferson City, Morristown, or White Pine are preferred.

How to Apply
You must apply through LinkedIn. Please submit your resume and include links to any current or past social media accounts you have personally managed.

Serving the needs of all families with young children,
Carter’s Inc. is the largest North American apparel retailer exclusively for babies and young children, encompassing Carter’s, OshKosh B’gosh, Skip*Hop and Little Planet brands. Meaningful work, constant learning, genuine people, and a community guided by core values that promote inclusion and innovation is in everything we do. There are many reasons to build your career at Carter's.

How You’ll Make An Impact

The Senior Manager, Retail Marketing & Activation Marketing is responsible for developing and leading the CRI strategy to drive store traffic, deepen customer engagement, and strengthen brand affinity through meaningful retail and consumer experiences, and community engagement initiatives. This leader will transform Carter’s stores into destinations by creating compelling reasons for families to visit beyond traditional shopping. Through the development of scalable experience programs, activations, and locally relevant events, this role will bring the brand to life in ways that foster connection, drives store traffic, customer acquisition, and generate measurable business impact.

The ideal candidate is a strategic marketer, experience builder, and consumer-focused leader who understands how to create memorable brand experiences while delivering against traffic, sales, and engagement objectives.

Retail Marketing & Activation Strategy – 30%

Develop and lead Carter's enterprise retail experiences strategy, transforming stores into destinations that build brand affinity, drives traffic and measurable business growth.
Create a long-term roadmap of family-focused experiences that strengthen brand relevance and support business objectives.
Identify opportunities to leverage seasonal moments, cultural occasions, partnerships, and community engagement to create meaningful consumer experiences in stores and beyond.
Partner closely with the Integrated Marketing and Creative Team to develop breakthrough retail concepts and consumer experiences that bring seasonal campaigns and brand storytelling to life within the store environment and beyond.
Collaborate with the Retail Store Experience Team to ensure retail experiences are seamlessly integrated into the physical environment, balancing operational feasibility with an exceptional consumer experience.

Store and Consumer Activation Programming – 30%

Develop new experiential platforms and scalable programs that can be deployed nationally while allowing for local market customization.
Identify whitespace opportunities that strengthen Carter's role within communities and create new reasons for families to visit stores.
Lead all aspects of retail store activation development and execution, including planning, budgets, vendors, registration platforms, customer communications, and measurement.
Ensure all experiences are operationally executable, customer-centric, and aligned with Carter’s brand standards.
Continuously evaluate industry trends and best practices to evolve the retail experience strategy.

Brand Relevance & Traffic Generation – 30%

Partner with Brand Management teams, Owned Channels, Loyalty, Social, PR, and Media teams to maximize awareness and attendance for retail experiences and events.
Develop customer acquisition strategies tied to experiential programs and community engagement efforts.
Support key business-driving moments including new store openings, relocations, remodels, flagship initiatives, and seasonal campaigns.
Leverage customer insights and local market trends to identify opportunities for traffic growth and engagement.

Measurement & Business Impact – 10%

Define success metrics and KPIs for all retail marketing and retail activation initiatives.
Analyze traffic, transactions, sales, customer acquisition, loyalty engagement, attendance, and customer satisfaction metrics.
Develop executive-level recaps and recommendations that inform future investment decisions.
Build business cases that demonstrate the impact of experiential marketing on retail performance and brand engagement.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

7–10+ years of experience in experiential marketing, retail marketing, brand experiences, community marketing, event marketing, or related disciplines.
Proven track record of developing consumer experiences that drive traffic, engagement, and measurable business results.
Strong strategic planning and project management capabilities.
Experience managing budgets, agencies, vendors, and cross-functional teams.
Strong analytical and business acumen with experience measuring program effectiveness and ROI.
Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Passion for building brands through meaningful consumer experiences and community engagement.

Make a Career At Carter’s

Career Development: Success starts from within, and we have several paths from which you can choose to enhance your career evolution. From Carter’s University to Toastmasters to mentorship programs and more, we encourage you to utilize these tools to elevate your professional prowess.

added.title: Vice President of Product Marketing
added.description:
Company Description
Bankable Limited is building Africa’s first financial health scoring platform, transforming six months of bank transaction data into a 0–100 score that helps individuals become bankable, often for the first time. The company addresses the gap where millions of Nigerians have bank accounts but no credit history, making it difficult for banks to assess lending risk. By analyzing financial behavior such as savings patterns, income consistency, spending stability, debt indicators, and resilience to emergencies through Open Banking data, Bankable provides actionable insights. The platform helps consumers understand and improve their financial health while enabling lenders to discover creditworthy borrowers they currently overlook. Bankable Limited is based in Abuja, Nigeria and is targeting a 2026 launch.
Role Description
The Vice President of Product Marketing is a full-time remote role responsible for shaping and executing the go-to-market strategy for Bankable’s financial health scoring platform. This role oversees product positioning, message development, and market segmentation to ensure the platform resonates with consumers, lenders, and partners across key African markets. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with product management to define value propositions, partnering with sales to develop enablement materials, and leading marketing initiatives that drive adoption and engagement. The VP will analyze market trends and customer insights, refine pricing and packaging strategies, manage key product launches, and guide cross-functional teams to deliver consistent, impactful campaigns. This role also involves establishing performance metrics, tracking product marketing effectiveness, and continuously optimizing strategies for growth and market leadership.
Qualifications

Demonstrated expertise in Go-to-Market Strategy and Positioning (Marketing), including market segmentation, messaging, and launch planning.
Strong background in Marketing and Product Management, with experience aligning product capabilities to customer needs and market opportunities.
Proven collaboration skills with Sales teams, including development of sales enablement tools, pitch materials, and competitive positioning.
Extensive leadership experience in product marketing or related functions within fintech, financial services, or data/analytics-driven organizations.
Ability to interpret market research, customer insights, and performance data to inform strategy and decision-making.
Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives in a high-growth, remote or distributed environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is an advantage.
Experience working in African markets or emerging markets and familiarity with Open Banking, credit scoring, or financial inclusion is highly beneficial.

Location: Hybrid 3+ days in office (Charlotte, NC)

Job Summary

We are passionate about our clients having a great experience and this also applies to our team and our future team members. Building a remarkable team is a top-level company priority. The Director of Marketing
is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role reporting directly to the CEO. This is a build role: you'll define and drive our go-to-market strategy, stand up the systems that connect marketing directly to sales results, and build our company’s brand presence across traditional, digital, and AI-driven channels. You'll work as a senior leader driving strategic decisions while executing as an individual contributor at the outset, backed by an external marketing agency for execution capacity, with the mandate to shape the function as it grows.

What You’ll Do

Build the sales + marketing growth engine. Design and run the connective tissue between marketing and sales — lead scoring and routing, sales enablement content, and closed-loop reporting from campaign to closed deal. This is the top priority of the role.
Drive near-term pipeline impact. Identify and execute quick wins that improve conversion on active sales opportunities while longer-term systems are being built.
Support development of go-to-market strategy. Define and execute GTM plans in close coordination with sales leadership and the executive team, including segmentation, positioning, and launch strategy for current and future offerings.
Build brand recognition. Develop and execute a multi-channel brand strategy that raises company visibility and credibility with HR and benefits decision-makers.
Grow qualified traffic and discoverability. Maximize the company’s visibility across traditional search (SEO/SEM), AI-driven search and assistants, and emerging channels.
Apply AI across marketing operations. Use AI tools to scale content creation, campaign execution, and reporting — increasing marketing output and speed without requiring a large internal team.
Partner on enterprise change management. Stay closely engaged as our products and capabilities evolve, ensuring the market is accurately informed, and sales has what it needs to sell effectively.
Partner across the product lifecycle. Work with product leadership from early development through launch, providing a marketing perspective at every stage.
Manage agency and vendor partnerships. Direct an external marketing agency and other vendors to extend the team's execution capacity and deliver against the strategy you set.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Maintain quality work that exemplifies and promotes our company’s core values.

Requirements

Who You Are

5+ years of progressive marketing experience, including B2B marketing in a growth-stage or fast-scaling company.
Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving the connection between marketing and sales, including lead scoring, routing, and sales enablement content.
Comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor and directing external agencies or vendors to extend capacity.
Working fluency with SEO/SEM and an informed point of view on AI-driven search and discoverability.
Practical experience using AI tools for content creation, marketing automation, or campaign execution.
Experience developing and to a managing a marketing budget that balances investment with value.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with sales, product, and executive stakeholders.
An individual that understands the value of providing a high level of customer service.

Preferred

Experience owning full marketing plan including go-to-market strategy end-to-end, from positioning through launch.
Marketing experience in benefits administration, HR technology, Insurtech, healthcare, or another regulated B2B services industry.
Experience marketing to employer/HR buyers and working with broker or channel partners.
Prior experience building a marketing function from an early stage.

Work Environment

FloresHR’s standard work hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET with an hour lunch. Roles may be approved for other schedules by managers. This role operates in a professional hybrid office environment based out of our Charlotte office (off West Morehead) (3+ days in office). This role is mostly sedentary and consists of prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. This role also utilizes other tools such as a phone, copy machine, and printer. Common programs often used are Outlook, Word, and Excel. This position frequently communicates with FloresHR team members and candidates and must be able to exchange accurate information clearly in these situations.

How We Support Our Team

At FloresHR, we invest in our people, our community and our technology and strive to provide work life balance, paired with professional growth for each of our employees. We provide an innovative benefit solution for our clients but that does not apply just to our clients. They extend to our team too!

Competitive Benefits – FloresHR offers competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits for employees and their families. We also provide company funded HSA’s, Pre- and Post-tax 401k’s with a company match up to 5%, and other great benefits such as Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Pet insurance, and more!
Work Life Balance – We want all our team members to have time to focus on themselves and their families. We offer a Monday - Friday schedule, a generous vacation policy and a Life Balance Reimbursement Plan to support this.
Community Involvement – We love to give back to our community, and we recognize that our team does too! We have a volunteer program in place to support our team members as they help the organizations’ they are passionate about.

Our Core Values & Diversity Focus

Our vision is to be the most admired benefits partner, and our core values and beliefs are:

We believe in always doing the right thing.
We believe that a remarkable service experience is possible.
We believe in trusting one another as an operating philosophy.
We believe that high performance teams deliver extraordinary results.
We believe in building benefits technology that converts the complex to easy.
We seek to empower, empathize, and respect our team members and our world.

We are committed to diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Overview

Join a Team That Changes Lives

For more than 170 years, Elwyn has been leading the way in supporting children, teens, and adults with autism, intellectual and developmental disabilities, and behavioral health challenges. As a mission-driven nonprofit, we’re here to create real change – helping people lead meaningful, fulfilling lives.

Now, we’re looking for passionate team members to join us. Here, your work will change lives – including your own. You’ll make an impact every day, find purpose in what you do, and grow in a career that truly matters.

At Elwyn, we take care of you while you care for others. We offer:

Generous Paid Time Off
Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision Benefit Packages
Earned Wage Access/On-Demand Pay
Paid On-the-Job Training
Tuition Reimbursement
Career Advancement Opportunities and Growth
Flexible Schedules
Retirement Savings Plan

Join us and be a part of something bigger. Apply today.

Job Description

Elwyn seeks a Marketing Business Partner
to foster a strategic alliance between an assigned division's business line and the Marketing team. As a trusted partner, the BP interacts with various levels within the business line to provide a broad range of marketing and communications expertise that supports business objectives and initiatives. You will partner with the business line and other parts of the Marketing team to provide guidance on things like developing marketing plans, developing marketing and communications content, tracking and reporting on marketing results, and staying up-to-date on marketing trends and best practices.

Essential Functions

Serve as a consultative partner for each client, understanding their needs and goals, and contributing marketing solutions to help clients achieve employee activation and engagement goals.
Develop strategies and tactics to support program education, growth and awareness for a variety of audiences.
Analyze, track and report on marketing results to clients and the marketing team, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
Work collaboratively with other members of the marketing team to develop and implement effective marketing campaigns.
Stay up-to-date on marketing trends and best practices, sharing knowledge and insights with the team and clients.
Serve as the project manager for marketing and communication projects for assigned areas including securing the support of other company partners.
Serve as a point person for crisis communication partnering with the ED of Marketing Communications and others as needed.
Develop and manage relationships with outside vendors needed to achieve desired results for specific campaigns.
Develop and execute effective planning calendars to help manage impact and resources.
Manage the budget for assigned projects.
Maintain a content library for assigned programs of reusable content and marketing materials.
Establish routine review and update of materials to ensure accuracy.
Actively develop and maintain knowledge of emerging marketing and communication practices being used in the marketplace.
Recommend new strategies and approaches.
Prepare reports with results of marketing and communication campaigns.
Use data and outcomes to adjust and recommend new ideas to improve efficacy of campaign elements.
Ensure that timelines are met.
Produce well written, error free products
Contribute to client relationships by providing excellent customer service and communication.
Share knowledge with other members of the MarComm team
Develop marketing plans that align with the client's business objectives and goals.
Maintain any assigned certifications.
Perform additional business-related tasks as assigned.

Qualifications, Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field, or seven years of experience operating as a marketing manager or client coordinator function. Advanced degree preferred.
Experience managing campaigns and promotions, from concept through execution
Ability to review and report on marketing analytics and outcomes
Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
Able to plan work and develop strategies without all the answers up front
Excellent Microsoft office suite skills including SharePoint, Excel, and Project
Knowledge of current marketing panning tools and a wide variety of Social Media sites including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, etc.
Current, valid driver’s license in the state of residence
Must possess a current, valid driver's license in state of residence, have a minimum of two (2) years of driving experience within the United States, and have an acceptable driving record
